  (
    "organic photovoltaic*" OR "organic solar cell*" OR "OPV" OR "OSC"
    OR "polymer solar cell*" OR "bulk heterojunction" OR "BHJ"
    OR "non-fullerene acceptor*" OR "NFA" OR "small molecule acceptor*"
    OR "organic semiconductor*" OR "conjugated polymer*"
    OR "perovskite-organic tandem" OR "organic tandem solar cell*"
  )
  AND
  (
    "power conversion efficiency" OR "PCE" OR "fill factor" OR "FF"
    OR "open circuit voltage" OR "Voc" OR "short circuit current" OR "Jsc"
    OR "charge transport" OR "charge mobility" OR "exciton"
    OR "morphology" OR "blend film" OR "active layer"
    OR "device stability" OR "degradation" OR "lifetime"
    OR "donor" OR "acceptor" OR "D-A" OR "HOMO" OR "LUMO"
    OR "Y6" OR "PM6" OR "PTB7" OR "PBDB-T" OR "IT-4F" OR "ITIC"
    OR "electron transport layer" OR "ETL" OR "hole transport layer" OR "HTL"
    OR "interface engineering" OR "interlayer" OR "additive"
    OR "ternary blend" OR "binary blend" OR "quaternary"
    OR "indoor photovoltaic*" OR "flexible solar cell*" OR "semitransparent"
  )
) AND PUBDATETXT(January 2025) AND DOCTYPE(ar)
